s: Transactional and marketing email delivery system handling sending, deliverability, bounce/complaint management, and template rendering.
w: Receives email requests (to, subject, template, variables) via API, renders templates with variable substitution, manages sending reputation through dedicated IPs and domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), handles bounces/complaints/unsubscribes via webhooks, and provides delivery analytics. Dedicated IPs warm up gradually; shared pools used for low-volume senders.
use: Transactional emails: password resets, order confirmations, shipping notifications
Marketing campaigns: newsletters, product announcements, promotional emails
System notifications: alert emails, report delivery, weekly digests
Multi-channel notifications alongside SMS and push (asynchronous email leg)
avoid: Real-time synchronous request paths where email send latency blocks user experience
Legal/regulatory notifications requiring guaranteed immediate delivery (use SMS or push)

size.emails_per_sec: ~1k-10k per provider account depending on reputation

pits: Shared IP reputation damage from one bad sender - use dedicated IPs for high-volume senders
Template rendering failures from unescaped variables - sanitize all user input in templates
tips: Email deliverability is about domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) and sending reputation
Transactional vs marketing emails have different deliverability requirements - separate streams
